correctness.rationale: For odd l>=3, the Legendre generating function gives a strictly positive odd cosine expansion P_l(cos theta)=sum_{odd k<=l}a_{lk}cos(k theta), a_{lk}=2 c_{(l+k)/2}c_{(l-k)/2}>0 with c_j=binom(2j,j)/4^j; sum a=1. Thus meridional support curvature rho_m=1-eps sum_{k>=3}(k²-1)a cos(k theta), and C=sum(k²-1)a=(l(l+1)-2)/2 from P_l′(1). The sharp |eps|<=1/C follows from the pole obstruction and the triangle bound. For zonal h, a(theta)=h sin theta+h_theta cos theta satisfies a′=rho_m cos theta, a(0)=a(pi)=0; integrating from the nearer pole shows rho_az=a/sin theta>=0, so meridional positivity is fully sufficient. Oddness makes width exactly 2; |eps|<=1/5 and |P_l|<=1 keep h>0. Spherical harmonic identities and integrated Bochner give V=4pi/3-2pi(l(l+1)-2)/(2l+1)eps²; the cubic integral vanishes by antipodal parity. Exact symbolic independent integration of h*rho_m*rho_az verified the volume for l=3,5,7,9,11, including 128pi/105 at l3. Strictly increasing denominator gives monotonic endpoint volumes. At boundary the positive cosine coefficients require cos(k theta)=1; l3 only k3 gives theta=0,2pi/3, whereas l>=5 has both k3 and k5 so theta=0 alone. Negative eps reflects theta. Algebraic checks for five degrees corroborate, not replace the all-l positive-coefficient proof.
residual_risks: Only one odd zonal Legendre mode at a time; no general harmonic mixture or global Blaschke-Lebesgue minimum claim.
The spectral volume formula itself is established prior work, not claimed original.

value.rationale: Exact maximum feasible amplitude is an invariant of a natural one-harmonic constant-width deformation in all odd degrees. The result gives a complete infinite-degree classification of convex feasibility, strict endpoint volume hierarchy, and the geometric transition from a genuine meridional zero-curvature ring at l3 to isolated axial degeneracy for every higher odd mode. This remains mathematically useful even though l3 and volume spectral formulas are separately known, and is not merely a known-table recomputation.
residual_risks: No claim of global least-volume body in three dimensions; restriction to a single zonal mode is essential.

final_claim: All odd-degree sharp zonal Legendre convexity, volume hierarchy and boundary curvature zeros
limitations: Previously published axial cubic paper completely covers l3 convexity/volume; novelty bounded to the uniform higher-degree classification and meridional degeneracy transition.
